_comment: The AWS account is not recorded here because the CDK CLI already resolves it from the
active credentials via CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT; hardcoding it would add a second source of
truth that could drift. Override with -c account=... if needed. `cdk synth` with no
credentials falls back to a placeholder account, which keeps the template reviewable in
CI but not deployable -- a concrete account is required because a cross-region reference
(the certificate ARN) cannot be resolved for an environment-agnostic stack.
hostedZoneName equals domainName because the zone is a delegated subdomain zone, so the
alias record is created at its apex. The hosted zone ID is deliberately absent: it is an
account-specific identifier, so it comes from SPOTISTATS_HOSTED_ZONE_ID or -c hostedZoneId=.
Omitting it makes `cdk synth` fail loudly rather than quietly dropping the DNS records.
